cameraInstructions: Film from the side with the working leg closest to the camera and the full body visible.

metrics.targetText: Keep the chest lifted with no more than 25 degrees of lean.
metrics.hint_good: Your upper body stayed controlled at the bottom.
metrics.hint_high: Your body leaned too far forward. Lift your chest and brace your core.

metrics.targetText: Use a comfortable step so the front knee stays naturally over the foot.
metrics.hint_good: Your step length kept the front knee in a balanced position.
metrics.hint_low: The front knee stayed too far back. Adjust the step so you can lower straight down.
metrics.hint_high: The front knee moved too far forward. Lengthen the stance slightly and lower with control.

metrics.targetText: Reach a front knee angle of about 75-110 degrees.
metrics.hint_good: Your front leg reached a useful lunge depth.
metrics.hint_low: You went very deep. Use a slightly smaller range and keep control.
metrics.hint_high: The lunge was shallow. Lower your hips a little more.

metrics.targetText: Let the rear knee lower with the body to about 70-120 degrees.
metrics.hint_good: Your rear knee followed the body down smoothly.
metrics.hint_low: The rear knee folded too deeply. Reduce the range slightly and stay balanced.
metrics.hint_high: The rear knee stayed too straight. Let it move closer to the floor.

metrics.targetText: Reach a similar bottom position on each lunge.
metrics.hint_good: Each lunge reached a similar depth.
metrics.hint_high: The lunges were different depths. Keep the same stance and control the bottom position.

metrics.targetText: Lower and stand with an even rhythm.
metrics.hint_good: Your lunges followed a steady rhythm.
metrics.hint_high: Some lunges were rushed. Lower and return at the same calm pace.
